failures.label: data beats memory
problems: fact: a figure from the data
failures.a: Not quite — your sleep usually lands a bit under 8 hours, even though last night you got 8 h 5 min. Your bedtime is usually in your normal range, so the main gap is that your usual time asleep is closer to 6 h 33 min to 7 h 33 min, not 8 hours.
